agentic-artifact-discovery.author: felipeblassioli
agentic-artifact-discovery.description: Portable agentic-artifact discovery pack with an explicit workflow skill and a reusable exploration subagent for understanding skill systems, workflow frameworks, subagent bundles, and Claude-style plugins.

cursor-companion.author: felipeblassioli
cursor-companion.description: Cursor runtime bundle with companion subagents, project rules, hook guard-rails, MCP templates, operational guides, and a bundled orientation skill.

cursor-skill-studio.author: felipeblassioli
cursor-skill-studio.description: Cursor pack covering the full skill lifecycle (write, maintain, audit). Ships skill-studio-write (greenfield, distillation, pack scaffolding, external intake, Claude-plugin adaptation, eval loop), skill-studio-audit (single-skill compliance audit, improvement recommendations, installed portfolio audit, deep repo-first-party overlap audit), and skill-studio-maintain (root-skill and pack releases, registry alignment, bundled-skill artifact edits, promotion/demotion, maturity classification, install verification). All three bundled skills are explicit-only.

engineering-workflows.author: felipeblassioli
engineering-workflows.description: Portable engineering workflow pack with bundled skills for code review, debugging, architecture, incident response, deploy readiness, documentation, standups, technical debt, and testing strategy.

gcp-log-investigation.author: felipeblassioli
gcp-log-investigation.description: Portable GCP log-investigation pack with a reusable log-reader subagent and production-safe guidance for Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, and GKE logs.

node-test-verifier.author: felipeblassioli
node-test-verifier.description: Portable Node and Jest verifier pack with a reusable subagent for low-noise, pass-fail-first verification with explicit evidence and optional coverage.

skill-consistency-auditor.author: felipeblassioli
skill-consistency-auditor.description: [DEPRECATED — superseded by cursor-skill-studio/skill-studio-audit per ADR-0005] Cursor pack for auditing installed skills to detect overlap, vagueness, duplicate aliases, and inconsistencies with docs/architecture.md. Pack still installs through this release; scheduled to move to packs/.archive/ in the stub-removal PR.
